summary.tagline: Explore the dramatic west coast cliffs and spectacular sea stacks of the Mainland.
summary.best_season: Evidence does not specify a best season; verify weather conditions before travel.
summary.seo_title: Visiting Yesnaby: Orkney's West Coast Cliffs

travel.headline: Check Local Ferry and Site Access Schedules
travel.reservation: While the coastline at Yesnaby is generally open for walking, visitors should check for any seasonal restrictions or changes in local access. Always verify ferry schedules to the islands as these are the primary bottleneck for arrival. Consult official island transport resources for the most current travel requirements.

days.title: West Coast Cliff Exploration

stops.name: Yesnaby
stops.detail: Visit this spectacular stretch of coastline located between Stromness and Skara Brae to view dramatic cliffs and sea stacks. Maintain a safe distance from the cliff edges while observing the coastal scenery.

days.driving: Allow 20-40 minutes; coastal road conditions and visibility vary.
days.note: Exercise extreme caution near the cliff edges due to wind and height.

intel.title: Coastal Access Points
intel.text: Specific parking capacity at Yesnaby is not documented in available evidence. Visitors should check local signage upon arrival for designated stopping areas.

intel.title: Connectivity Gaps
intel.text: Cellular signal strength along the remote west coast of the Mainland is unverified. Do not rely on digital maps for navigation in these coastal areas.

intel.title: Supply Availability
intel.text: Fuel locations are not listed in the source evidence for the west coast. It is recommended to refuel in larger settlements like Stromness before heading to remote coastal sites.

intel.title: Coastal Visibility
intel.text: Weather can change rapidly on the coast, affecting views of the sea stacks. Allow extra time for conditions to clear if mist or fog is present.

intel.title: Terrain and Safety
intel.text: The path follows the cliff line between Stromness and Skara Brae. Ensure you stay well back from the edges as the terrain can be unstable.

plan.arrival: Upon arrival via ferry in Stromness, collect your vehicle and secure local supplies before driving north toward the west coast sites.
plan.vehicle: Standard vehicles are suitable for the main roads, though drivers should be aware of narrow coastal lanes; check rental agreements for island-specific restrictions.
plan.goldenHour: Yesnaby offers a western-facing perspective for sunset, though cloud cover frequently dictates visibility.
